title: Judgement of Odin vs Ghosts of Lemesos
lede:
Judgement of Odin won 31-22 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4, scoring objectives in every round (19 VP) against the Ghosts of Lemesos' 7.

Round 4 decided it: Odin's Einherjar took the centre back from Cultist Troopers 3, and that one round paid the Judgement 13 VP, with BREAK THEIR HOLD (3), TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY (3) and OBJECTIVE RELAY (2) on top of two objectives.
result_line: Judgement of Odin win 31-22 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). Judgement of Odin lined up on row 12 in front of its HQ at (7,13): Corporaider Squad 1 at (3,12), the Valkyrie with the Shieldmaidens at (4,12) (they began the battle in the air), Corporaider Squad 2 at (5,12), the Grey Huskarls at (7,12), the Runesmith at (9,12), the Hersir with Odin's Einherjar at (10,12) and Corporaider Squad 3 at (11,12). Ghosts of Lemesos set up on rows 1 and 2 around its HQ at (7,1): the Evil-Eye Serpent at (3,1), Cultist Troopers 2, 1 and 3 at (3,2), (5,2) and (6,2), The High Admiral with Knight of Tehom 1 at (9,2) and the Tide Captain with Knight of Tehom 2 at (11,2). The Judgement had a squad for every objective and fast melee units; the Ghosts' cheap Cultist Troopers were their bodies for the objectives. The Ghosts had Priority with fewer units on the battlefield (9 to 10).

1.title: The Judgement are first to the objectives

feed.text: Primaries revealed: BREAK THEIR HOLD for the Judgement, IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS for the Ghosts; secondaries kept, FOCUSED FIRE and OMNIPRESENCE. Each side spent all 3 CP and bought nothing: the Judgement Double Time on Corporaider Squad 3 and Scouting Order on the Grey Huskarls, the Ghosts both on Knight of Tehom 2.

Corporaider Squad 3 (with the Double Time), Corporaider Squad 2 and the Grey Huskarls took the centre at 7,8, 6,8 and 8,8, and the Hersir and Odin's Einherjar the right objective at 12,7. The Shieldmaidens flew to 1,7 on the left. The Ghosts came forward to meet them: both Knight of Tehom squads to 9,5 and 9,6, Cultist Troopers 3 to 8,6, Cultist Troopers 2 to 6,6 and the Evil-Eye Serpent to 7,5.
Only one unit acted. The Grey Huskarls hit Cultist Troopers 2 with 6 of 8 shots and none were saved: 6 damage (20 to 14), and 3 Loots for the Judgement. The Ghosts passed with nothing in range.
The Judgement held the centre on OC 23 vs 17 and the right on OC 7 vs 0, 5 VP. The Shieldmaidens, still in the air, did not take the left. 5-0.

2.title: Charges both ways, and the Judgement hold all three

feed.text: The Ghosts spent all 3 CP on Troop Requisition: a fourth Cultist Troopers at 9,2. The Judgement spent 2 of 3 on Double Time for Odin's Einherjar, which bought nothing. FOCUSED FIRE expired; IRON CURTAIN and IRON GRIP kept.

Knight of Tehom 1 and The High Admiral charged the three Judgement units on the centre from 9,5. Corporaider Squad 2 passed its Fall Back test to 4,9; Corporaider Squad 3 and the Grey Huskarls failed theirs and broke away in disorder, one model lost each, to 9,10 and 12,7. Odin's Einherjar and the Hersir charged back from the right into five Ghosts units at 8,7. The High Admiral's and the Tide Captain's Overwatch against them rolled nothing: each weapon was a FREE weapon marked used and then skipped. Cultist Troopers 3 failed its own Fall Back test and broke away to 5,5. On the left, Cultist Troopers 1 ran to 1,5 into Corporaider Squad 1's Overwatch (6 damage); the Shieldmaidens left the left objective for 6,7 and lost a model to Cultist Troopers 1's Overwatch.

The High Admiral struck first (INI 9, +3 for the charge) but did no damage; Odin's Einherjar hit back 4 times for 6 on Knight of Tehom 1 (15 to 9). Both Knight of Tehom squads used Get Over Here! on Odin's Einherjar for 3 HP in all. The Hersir's Mark of Acquisition gave +1 DMG against The High Admiral's pair, and the Shieldmaidens' Rune-Shotguns hit 4 of 6 for 6 more: Knight of Tehom 1 down to 3 HP, one model. The Valkyrie's Chooser of the Slain went on the Evil-Eye Serpent, the Runesmith inscribed Rune of Gale on Corporaider Squad 3 for 2 Loots, and two Cultist Troopers squads shot Corporaider Squad 1 for 4 (10 to 6).

The Judgement held all three: the centre on OC 7 vs 6, the left through Corporaider Squad 1 at 0,8 (OC 6 vs 0) and the right through the Grey Huskarls (OC 2 vs 0), 7 VP. IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid the Ghosts 3. 12-3.

3.title: Three Ghosts units die, and the Ghosts take two objectives anyway

feed.text: The Judgement spent 2 of 4 CP on Double Time for Corporaider Squad 3 and later 1 on Go to Ground for Odin's Einherjar. The Ghosts spent 2 of 3 on Double Time for the new Cultist Troopers. The High Admiral's Covetous Raider borrowed the Hersir's Rune of Protection for the round. IRON CURTAIN completed for the Judgement as the Movement Phase began, +2 VP and +1 CP; TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY and BAR THE GATES kept.

The new Cultist Troopers used the Double Time to reach 14,7 on the right objective, and Cultist Troopers 3 walked onto the centre at 6,7. On the left the Judgement charged: the Shieldmaidens and the Valkyrie landed on Cultist Troopers 1 at 1,6 with Corporaider Squad 1 beside them, and Corporaider Squad 2 charged Cultist Troopers 2. Knight of Tehom 1, at 3 HP, tried to Fall Back from Odin's Einherjar, failed its test on a 1 and the 3 True Damage of breaking away destroyed it: Knight of Tehom 1 destroyed. The High Admiral and Knight of Tehom 2 got away to 5,5 and 9,5, and the Evil-Eye Serpent charged Corporaider Squad 2.

The new Cultist Troopers shot the Grey Huskarls at 12,7: 9 hits from 18 dice, 3 through, Grey Huskarls destroyed. Corporaider Squad 2 struck first (INI 8, +3) with 7 hits for 14: Cultist Troopers 2 destroyed, 7 Loots. The Serpent hit Corporaider Squad 2 for 4. Corporaider Squad 1 took Cultist Troopers 1 from 8 to 2 and the Valkyrie finished it: Cultist Troopers 1 destroyed. Go to Ground held Cultist Troopers 3's volley on Odin's Einherjar to 2 damage.

With the Judgement's units pulled out to the left, the Ghosts won the centre on OC 9 vs 5 (Cultist Troopers 3) and the right on OC 10 vs 1, 5 VP; the Judgement kept the left, 2. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Judgement 2, for Odin's Einherjar on the centre and the Runesmith on the right. IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid the Ghosts 3 and IRON GRIP 2 VP and 1 CP. 18-13.

4.title: Odin's Einherjar retake the centre for 13 VP

feed.text: The Ghosts spent all 5 CP: Troop Requisition (3) for a fifth Cultist Troopers at 6,2 and Double Time (2) to run it to 3,5. The Judgement held 5 and spent 1, on Go to Ground for the Shieldmaidens. The Evil-Eye Serpent's Covetous Raider borrowed Corporaider Squad 2's Rune of Arrow Protection. New secondaries: OBJECTIVE RELAY and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY.

Corporaider Squad 2 broke away from the Serpent to 6,10. The High Admiral came back to 6,6 through Corporaider Squad 3's Overwatch (2 damage); the Tide Captain's Overwatch on the Shieldmaidens was skipped again as a used FREE weapon. Odin's Einherjar and the Hersir charged Cultist Troopers 3 from 7,8, and their Svinfylking moved the Shieldmaidens to 8,7, onto the centre from the left, which completed OBJECTIVE RELAY: +2 VP and +1 CP.

Knight of Tehom 2's Get Over Here! dragged Corporaider Squad 3 to 7,6 and The High Admiral hit it for 5 (7 to 2). The Hersir spent 1 Loot on Greed Manifestation (+1 AR) and hit Cultist Troopers 3 for 5 (17 to 12); Cultist Troopers 3 then finished Corporaider Squad 3 (Corporaider Squad 3 destroyed) and Took Ground to 7,6. The Serpent and Corporaider Squad 1 traded 2 each. Then the Cultist Troopers at 14,7 fired on their own Cultist Troopers 3: 6 hits from 18 dice, 5 damage (9 to 4).

The Judgement took the centre back on OC 11 vs 6 and kept the left on OC 4 vs 2, 5 VP; the Ghosts kept the right, 2. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 for the centre the Ghosts had held at the start of the round, and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY 3. The Ghosts completed OMNIPRESENCE with 2 OC or more on every objective (+4) and IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid 3. 31-22, the Judgement past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Judgement of Odin took 19 VP from objectives, 5 from BREAK THEIR HOLD and 7 from secondaries (IRON CURTAIN 2, TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY 3, OBJECTIVE RELAY 2). It held all three objectives in Round 2 and two in Round 4. Ghosts of Lemesos scored only 7 objective VP, all in Rounds 3 and 4. Its Primary, IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS, paid the full 3 in each of Rounds 2 to 4 (9 VP), and OMNIPRESENCE (4) and IRON GRIP (2) added 6. Its Primary pays for units standing outside its deployment zone, not for ground held, so it scored the same 3 whether the Ghosts were winning the objectives or not.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

Odin's Einherjar with the Hersir was the Judgement's best unit: 8.6 VP, 6 objective VP hinged on it, on the centre from Round 2 to the end, and the charge in Round 4 that took the centre back. It took no action in three rounds (its best leftover was Plunder at 0.3), but holding the centre was the job. Corporaider Squad 1 held the left from Round 2 on (7.3 VP, 6 hinged) and put 12 damage into Cultist Troopers 1 before the Valkyrie finished it. Corporaider Squad 2's charge into Cultist Troopers 2 was the battle's biggest hit, 14 damage. The Valkyrie and the Shieldmaidens were more mobile than useful: they began in the air on the left objective without taking it, left it for the centre in Round 2 (5 squares the digest marks as undone), then went back to finish Cultist Troopers 1 in Round 3.

For the Ghosts, the Cultist Troopers bought with Troop Requisition in Round 2 were the best value on the table: 8.1 VP for 10 RP, holding the right from Round 3 and killing the Grey Huskarls. Cultist Troopers 3 took the centre in Round 3 (5.3 VP). The expensive units did little: The High Admiral (70 RP) did 5 damage and 1.8 VP, the two Knight of Tehom squads (68 RP) 3 damage between them, the Tide Captain none, and the Evil-Eye Serpent 6 damage for 52 RP. The Ghosts' Overwatch lost three shots to the FREE weapon fault (below).

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Ghosts could not do

Hold the centre. Their charge into it in Round 2 cost Knight of Tehom 1 twelve of its 15 HP to Odin's Einherjar's counterattack and the Shieldmaidens' guns, and left the Judgement still on it. They took it in Round 3 only after the Judgement had sent the Shieldmaidens and the Valkyrie to the left, and lost it in Round 4 to one charge. Two of their three original Cultist Troopers squads were destroyed in Round 3 and the third was down to 4 HP by the end; the two Troop Requisitions came in at the back. BAR THE GATES (no enemy unit in their half) never had a chance, with the Shieldmaidens at 1,6 in Round 3 and Corporaider Squad 1 at 1,6 and the Runesmith at 10,6 in Round 4. TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY was still open when the battle ended.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • Overwatch, Rounds 2 and 4: The High Admiral's Drowned Bore and the Tide Captain's Pirate Pistol were each marked used as a FREE weapon and then skipped, so they rolled nothing against Odin's Einherjar's charge in Round 2, and the Tide Captain rolled nothing against the Shieldmaidens in Round 4. This is the known engine bug, not an AI choice.
  • Round 3, Knight of Tehom 1: at 3 HP it tried to Fall Back from Odin's Einherjar on a test it needed 6s to pass, and the breakaway damage killed it. The Fall Back record calls it doubtful: staying risked 6 expected damage, and leaving gained nothing.
  • Round 4, friendly fire: the Cultist Troopers at 14,7 fired 18 dice at their own Cultist Troopers 3 for 5 damage. Cultist Troopers 3 had just Taken Ground onto 7,6, the square of the Corporaider Squad 3 it had killed. It looks like an attack that should never have been legal, not a choice.
  • Round 1: both sides spent 3 CP on Double Time and Scouting Order that the record prices at nothing; every Ghosts unit then passed its Action Phase with no legal action.
  • Loots: the Judgement took 24 Loots from kills and spent 3 (Rune of Gale 2, Greed Manifestation 1); 21 were left at the end.
  • Fall Back record: of its 19 decisions, 8 were Fall Backs; some holds are charge-planning probes with no enemy adjacent, such as Cultist Troopers 3 in Round 3 (danger 0) and the Cultist Troopers at 14,7 in Round 4.

Most of this is the armies. The Judgement put more OC on the objectives earlier, and its melee won the exchanges that mattered. The engine's Overwatch fault and the friendly fire took dice and models off the Ghosts, but at 12-3 after two rounds the battle was already leaning hard one way.

closing_title: First there, and back in time
closing: The Judgement of Odin were on every objective by Round 2. When the Ghosts finally took the centre, Odin's Einherjar charged straight back and the round's secondaries finished it. The Ghosts' Primary paid every round, but it rewards standing in the open, not holding ground, and the objectives went the other way.
